summary: Extends Kerberos with a new authorization data type, AD-AUTHENTICATION-INDICATOR. It lets a service ticket carry a note about how strongly the client was authenticated, so services can use that note in access decisions. It updates RFC 4120.

eli5.summary: When you enter a building, your badge could show whether you proved who you are with a password or a fingerprint too. The guard can then decide which doors to open.

questions: how to tell authentication strength in kerberos tickets
